ModMetaData.name: Agent Bridge
ModMetaData.author: Akseleron
ModMetaData.description:
Control RimWorld from AI agents and scripts — Claude Code, Codex, any MCP client or plain HTTP — without screenshots or mouse coordinates.
Fair play lets any AI play your colony with exactly a player's abilities — no cheats.
A local JSON server (127.0.0.1 only, token-protected) exposes ~110 commands: observe the colony (snapshot, pawns, text map, alerts, events), give orders (draft, move, attack, gizmos with targeting, right-click menus, designations, construction, work priorities), manage time precisely (run N ticks, wait for events), handle dialogs and letters, save/load, run any Dev-mode debug action, and — for modders — reflect on live objects and run C# in the game.
• Works in every language: commands use defNames and stable keys, not translated labels. • No required dependencies. Harmony, if present, adds cell targeting, exact tick stops and event hooks. • Other mods can add their own commands without depending on this one. • Mod settings: read-only mode, permission levels, connected-agent list, recent commands, on-screen indicator. • Optional anonymous statistics and error reports (can be turned off; see PRIVACY.md).
Tools (CLI and MCP server) are in the Tools folder; see README on GitHub.
